title: Saw it in a dream first
content: There’s a big staircase in the mall world and I remember once I went to the library in my city for the first time and saw the exact place that was in my mall world dreams, except i’d never been there before in real life. It was so surreal I thought I might have actually been dreaming when this happened. I have no idea how this happened, other places in the mall world are similar to the malls in my city but this was truly the first unique experience like this where i recognized something from my dream in my life instead of recognizing something from my life in my dreams.
